PROOF_IDS_NOTE: proofs 10-14 (mission/verifier receipts) and proof 3 (evidence-backed graphs). The attestation is the independent-verifier receipt that gates VERIFIED status.
PURPOSE: Clean-room re-derivation of Phoenix's trace->evaluation->evidence mechanism: a judgment attestation object bound to a span (trace_id, span_id) carrying name, label, score, explanation, annotator kind + identity, typed evidence refs, and a canonical-bytes digest; upsert-by-(span_id,name,identifier) for judge verdicts and append-only for notes; explicit failure records (score=None); attempts as spans in one trace. The verdict receipt that lets proofs 10-14 (worker result -> independent verification -> VERIFIED) close with evidence.
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: A judgment attestation bound to a span: {span_ref: (trace_id, span_id), name, result: {label, score, explanation}, annotator_kind, annotator_identity, evidence_refs: [...], digest over canonical bytes}. PING has evidence, events, missions, and verifiers, but no primitive recording a judge's verdict on a specific unit of work as a bound, queryable, tamper-evident receipt. This is the receipt proofs 11 (reject bad result), 12 (fallback attempt succeeds), and 13 (VERIFIED only after independent verification) require.
SOURCE_PATH: src/phoenix/db/models.py (annotation/experiment type aliases), src/phoenix/trace/schemas.py (Span/SpanContext), src/phoenix/server/api/types + routers (SpanAnnotation/TraceAnnotation, /v1/span_annotations, /v1/trace_annotations), evals/pxi (online evaluator contract), packages/phoenix-evals (Score class), docs/phoenix (evaluations, tracing, release notes)
